Glacier Hide Quirk.name: Glacier Hide Quirk
Glacier Hide Quirk.description:
🧊 Ice forms as plates over your skin and hardens to near stone.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Ice and Hardening: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach and duration, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you send a ridge of stony frost five meters along the ground and strike with frost-hardened knuckles.
📈 With training: slide tracks, your plated back as cover for allies, a cold bear-hug restraint, armored ice shields grown for others, armor-cracking blows and an anchored stance nothing pushes over.
⚠️ Heat melts your plates.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as the cold of your own armor stiffens your joints.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eijiro Kirishima (Hardening), Shoto Todoroki (Half-Cold Half-Hot, cold side).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Output +10, Blocking +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Rime Wedge, Frostplate Knuckle
🛡️ Resists: cold, bludgeoning
Glacier Hide Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: near-stone ice plating and short frost ridges along touched surfaces; at first a limb or torso plates instantly and turns fists, knives, bats and pistol rounds about thirty seconds; knuckles dent a car door; a frozen line of about five meters. More needs learned techniques. Limits: fire and heat melt the plates; electricity and gas hurt; worn long, the cold slows sprint and reflexes; they sink in water. Quirk Strain: light: ridge, plated fist; moderate: slide track, shell guard, bear hug, shed shields; heavy: armor-cracking blow; severe: signature glacier stance, block-wide redoubt. Fusion: Ice and Hardening: about half pure Ice reach, half pure Hardening duration; no room-wide flash-freeze or unchilled armor; only it makes petrified plates to anchor down or detach as shields for others. Type: Emitter (also fits Transformation). Law: unlicensed plate strikes or pins are assault, anchored ice cracking pavement property damage. Look: grinding blue-gray ice.
